keychain.title: Keychain
keychain.header.queued: Playing as %s · %s is next when you leave
keychain.empty.hint: Add a Microsoft or offline account below.
keychain.no_matches: No accounts match your search or filter.
keychain.migration_failed: Accounts from the old Keychain could not be imported. See the log for details.
keychain.filter.tooltip: Show all accounts, only Microsoft or offline accounts, or only favorites.
keychain.sort.name: Name
keychain.sort.tooltip: Favorites always come first. Custom is your own order: rearrange it with the arrows or Alt+Up/Down.
keychain.remove.title: Remove %s?
keychain.remove.message: The account is deleted from Keychain. You can add it again at any time.
keychain.remove.message_active: You stay signed in as this account until you switch or restart, but it is deleted from Keychain.
keychain.vault.unreadable: Your saved accounts could not be unlocked.
keychain.vault.unreadable.hint: This happens after moving to another computer or Windows user. Nothing was deleted.
keychain.vault.reset.done: Started a new vault. The old file was kept as a backup.
keychain.toast.queued.title: Switching to %s
keychain.toast.queued.body: This happens as soon as you leave this world.
keychain.toast.queue_cancelled: Staying on your current account instead of %s
keychain.toast.switch_failed.body: You are still signed in as before. See the log for details.
keychain.toast.save_failed: Keychain could not save your accounts
keychain.signin.title: Sign in with Microsoft
keychain.signin.subtitle: Add a Minecraft: Java Edition account
keychain.signin.browser.hint: Microsoft's sign-in page opened in your browser. Sign in there, then come back here. Nothing opened? Use Copy link and paste it into your browser.
keychain.error.timed_out: Sign-in took too long. Try again.
keychain.error.network: Could not reach Microsoft. Check your internet connection and try again.
keychain.error.client_id_rejected: Microsoft did not accept the Azure app ID. If you set a custom one in Settings, check it or clear it to use Keychain's default.
keychain.error.client_misconfigured: The Azure app is not set up for browser sign-in. In your Azure app, allow public client flows and add the http://localhost redirect, or clear the custom app ID in Settings.
keychain.error.app_not_approved: Minecraft refused this Azure app. Custom apps must be approved by Mojang before they can sign in to Minecraft. Clear the custom app ID in Settings to use Keychain's default.
keychain.error.declined: Sign-in was declined or not finished in the browser.
keychain.error.session_revoked: This account's saved sign-in has expired or was revoked. Sign in with Microsoft again.
keychain.error.no_xbox_profile: This Microsoft account has no Xbox profile yet. Sign in once at xbox.com to create one, then try again.
keychain.error.xbox_region_blocked: Xbox Live is not available in this account's country or region.
keychain.error.xbox_age_verification: This account needs age verification. Complete it at xbox.com, then try again.
keychain.error.xbox_child_account: This is a child account. An adult must add it to a Microsoft family group before it can play.
keychain.error.xbox_banned: This account is banned from Xbox Live.
keychain.error.no_minecraft: This Microsoft account does not own Minecraft: Java Edition, or has not created a Minecraft profile yet.
keychain.error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
keychain.error.service_error: Microsoft or Minecraft services returned an unexpected error. Try again in a moment.
keychain.offline.title: Add Offline Account
keychain.offline.subtitle: For singleplayer and offline-mode servers
keychain.offline.name: Username
keychain.offline.invalid: Use 3 to 16 letters, numbers or underscores.
keychain.offline.duplicate: You already have an offline account with this name.
keychain.offline.ready: Looks good. Press Enter to add and use it.
keychain.settings.title: Keychain Settings
keychain.settings.title_button.tooltip: Show the Keychain button on the title screen.
keychain.settings.pause_button.tooltip: Show the Keychain button in the pause menu.
keychain.settings.multiplayer_button.too: Show the Keychain button on the multiplayer server list.
keychain.settings.restore.tooltip: When the game starts, switch back to the account you used last instead of the launcher's account.
keychain.settings.shared.tooltip: Use one account list for every Minecraft instance on this computer, instead of one per instance. Your current accounts are copied over.
keychain.settings.need_button: Keep at least one Keychain button
keychain.settings.need_button.body: Or bind the Open Keychain key in Controls first.
keychain.settings.client_id.hint: Leave empty to use Keychain's default
keychain.settings.client_id.custom: Using your Azure app. It needs personal Microsoft accounts, public client flows, an http://localhost redirect and Mojang's approval.
keychain.settings.client_id.invalid: That is not a valid app ID. It looks like 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.
keychain.settings.client_id.not_saved: The custom app ID was not valid and was not saved
